source.dataset: GDR submission 1255 updated MT model cell-center inversion package

transform.sceneCrs: local meters, X east, Y north, Z up
transform.resampling: Gaussian-weighted blend of cell-center source values with bounded in-range extrapolation (continuity-first); not nearest-bin
transform.scalarEncoding: uint8 normalized over source log10 resistivity range; mask.u8 defines occupied voxels (empty over large unconstrained voids)

caveats: Source-derived visualization volume resampled from the inversion model.
Empty voxels are transparent through mask.u8.
This is not an interpreted geological model, target, or resource estimate.
